name: Loopbee improves itself
description: Weekdays, hourly: take the oldest open Loopbee issue labelled agent-ready that a maintainer opened, fix it in a fresh worktree following AGENTS.md and LESSONS.md, stop for review, then open the pull request. The same definition works for any repository that has an AGENTS.md: point the folder at it.

steps.name: Fix the issue
steps.prompt: Fix the GitHub issue Loopbee gives you, following AGENTS.md (“Working from an issue”) and LESSONS.md (“How to add a lesson”): reproduce it with a failing test, fix every place with the same cause, add or update the lesson, and run go vet ./... and go test ./... yourself. If the issue is unclear or needs a product decision, change nothing and report it as blocked with the question to ask.
